visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a robust physique, clad in a black performance t-shirt and matching shorts, stands over a loaded trap bar on a wooden lifting platform within a professional fitness facility. The environment features specialized strength training machines and prominent wall graphics with traditional characters and English text, all illuminated by bright, high-contrast overhead studio lighting. (2) He crouches low, gripping the side handles of the hexagonal bar while maintaining a focused gaze. As he drives upward, his facial muscles tighten significantly, and his eyes squint with extreme physical exertion. The heavy green and blue weighted plates rise steadily from the floor until his body is in a fully upright, locked position. (3) After holding the peak of the movement for a fraction of a second, he releases his grip, allowing the weighted bar to drop back to the wooden platform. He stands up straight, adjusts his stance, and prepares his breathing for the subsequent repetition of the heavy lifting sequence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Background music featuring a steady electronic synthesizer beat and sharp percussion begins. A male coach's voice, speaking in Mandarin with an authoritative and encouraging tone, provides rhythmic cues such as '好' (Good) and '拉起來' (Pull it up). The speech has a clear rising intonation pattern, indicating high arousal and motivational intent. (2) A sudden, high-intensity percussive impact sound occurs, characterized by a sharp transient and wide frequency bandwidth, suggesting a heavy object striking a wooden surface. The voice of the coach continues to command the space with loud, projected instructions including '胸好' (Chest up) and '再一次' (One more time), while the lifter's heavy exhalations and grunts are audible under the mix. (3) The sequence repeats with consistent BPM in the BGM. The speaker's pitch variability remains high as he calls out '丟' (Drop), followed immediately by another massive thud of the weights hitting the floor. The overall acoustic environment is that of a clean, resonant indoor space with minimal background interference.
